scope: Live Kubernetes API admission for one case-owned, namespaced synthetic PSAExceptionRecord CRD. Compares one incomplete record before and after a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, checks each required declaration independently, and persists one complete synthetic record. No Pod or other workload is created, no PSA exemption is installed, and deployed-exception enforcement, production registers, audit backends, and Secret data are out of scope.
